draft.subject: Photographing the French-American Piano Society's recital at Weill Recital Hall.
draft.body: I photograph performing arts in New York and saw you're presenting a recital at Weill Recital Hall on September 12. I shoot unobtrusive, no-flash documentary coverage and think it would suit your program. My rate is $250 an hour plus tax, one-hour minimum, with the gallery delivered within two weeks. Recent work is at danwrightphotography.com/music. Let me know how that lands.

results.alreadyCoveredNote: The organization's site lists a Photographer in Residence on its About page.
